svg.title: I build small, sharp tools: network utilities, security helpers and computer vision experiments. Self taught, I develop on mobile and write most of my code on an Android phone with my friends Claude Gpt Minimax Deepseek and Gemini. I'm Builder behind InfinityNet. Posting whatever I want.
